title: BigP3BCI Study A — P300 BCI EEG dataset (13 healthy subjects, Mainsah et al. 2025)
description: A derivative P300 brain-computer interface dataset (Study A of the BigP3BCI collection) with 32-channel EEG from 13 healthy subjects, one session each, performing a visual speller task with a 6x6 checkerboard paradigm. Events are labeled as target or non-target and annotated with HED 8.4.0. The data were processed and BIDS-formatted with the MOABB framework for machine-learning benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) using 32 channels in a 10-20 montage at 256 Hz with a 60 Hz line-frequency notch. Subjects performed a visual P300 speller with a 6x6 checkerboard stimulus in row-column and random presentation modes. Epochs spanned 0 to 1.0 s post-stimulus with binary target/non-target labels.
